record.bible_text: Woe<WH01945> to her that is filthy<WH04754><WTH8802> and polluted<WH01351><WTH8737>, to the oppressing<WH03238><WTH8802> city<WH05892>! <RF>her...: or, gluttonous: Heb. craw<Rf>

She obeyed<WH08085><WTH8804> not the voice<WH06963>; she received<WH03947><WTH8804> not correction<WH04148>; she trusted<WH0982><WTH8804> not in the LORD<WH03068>; she drew not near<WH07126><WTH8804> to her God<WH0430>. <RF>correction: or, instruction<Rf>

Her princes<WH08269> within<WH07130> her <FI>are<Fi> roaring<WH07580><WTH8802> lions<WH0738>; her judges<WH08199><WTH8802> <FI>are<Fi> evening<WH06153> wolves<WH02061>; they gnaw not the bones<WH01633><WTH8804> till the morrow<WH01242>.

Her prophets<WH05030> <FI>are<Fi> light<WH06348><WTH8802> <FI>and<Fi> treacherous<WH0900> persons<WH0582>: her priests<WH03548> have polluted<WH02490><WTH8765> the sanctuary<WH06944>, they have done violence<WH02554><WTH8804> to the law<WH08451>.

The just<WH06662> LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> in the midst<WH07130> thereof; he will not do<WH06213><WTH8799> iniquity<WH05766>: every<WH01242> morning<WH01242> doth he bring<WH05414><WTH8799> his judgment<WH04941> to light<WH0216>, he faileth<WH05737><WTH8738> not; but the unjust<WH05767> knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> no shame<WH01322>. <RF>every...: Heb. morning by morning<Rf>

I have cut off<WH03772><WTH8689> the nations<WH01471>: their towers<WH06438> are desolate<WH08074><WTH8738>; I made their streets<WH02351> waste<WH02717><WTH8689>, that none passeth by<WH05674><WTH8802>: their cities<WH05892> are destroyed<WH06658><WTH8738>, so that there is no man<WH0376>, that there is none inhabitant<WH03427><WTH8802>. <RF>towers: or, corners<Rf>

I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Surely thou wilt fear<WH03372><WTH8799> me, thou wilt receive<WH03947><WTH8799> instruction<WH04148>; so their dwelling<WH04583> should not be cut off<WH03772><WTH8735>, howsoever<WH0834><WH03605> I punished<WH06485><WTH8804> them: but<WH0403> they rose early<WH07925><WTH8689>, <FI>and<Fi> corrupted<WH07843><WTH8689> all their doings<WH05949>.<CM>

Therefore wait<WH02442><WTH8761> ye upon me, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, until the day<WH03117> that I rise up<WH06965><WTH8800> to the prey<WH05706>: for my determination<WH04941> <FI>is<Fi>  to gather<WH0622><WTH8800> the nations<WH01471>, that I may assemble<WH06908><WTH8800> the kingdoms<WH04467>, to pour<WH08210><WTH8800> upon them mine indignation<WH02195>, <FI>even<Fi> all my fierce<WH02740> anger<WH0639>: for all the earth<WH0776> shall be devoured<WH0398><WTH8735> with the fire<WH0784> of my jealousy<WH07068>.

For then will I turn<WH02015><WTH8799> to the people<WH05971> a pure<WH01305><WTH8803> language<WH08193>, that they may all call<WH07121><WTH8800> upon the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068>, to serve<WH05647><WTH8800> him with one<WH0259> consent<WH07926>. <RF>language: Heb. lip<Rf> <RF>consent: Heb. shoulder<Rf>

From beyond<WH05676> the rivers<WH05104> of Ethiopia<WH03568> my suppliants<WH06282>, <FI>even<Fi> the daughter<WH01323> of my dispersed<WH06327><WTH8803>, shall bring<WH02986><WTH8686> mine offering<WH04503>.

In that day<WH03117> shalt thou not be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> for all thy doings<WH05949>, wherein thou hast transgressed<WH06586><WTH8804> against me: for then I will take away<WH05493><WTH8686> out of the midst<WH07130> of thee them that rejoice<WH05947> in thy pride<WH01346>, and thou shalt no more<WH03254><WTH8686> be haughty<WH01361><WTH8800> because of my holy<WH06944> mountain<WH02022>. <RF>because...: Heb. in my holy<Rf>

I will also leave<WH07604><WTH8689> in the midst<WH07130> of thee an afflicted<WH06041> and poor<WH01800> people<WH05971>, and they shall trust<WH02620><WTH8804> in the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068>.

The remnant<WH07611> of Israel<WH03478> shall not do<WH06213><WTH8799> iniquity<WH05766>, nor speak<WH01696><WTH8762> lies<WH03577>; neither shall a deceitful<WH08649> tongue<WH03956> be found<WH04672><WTH8735> in their mouth<WH06310>: for they shall feed<WH07462><WTH8799> and lie down<WH07257><WTH8804>, and none shall make <FI>them<Fi> afraid<WH02729><WTH8688>.<CM>

Sing<WH07442><WTH8798>, O daughter<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726>; shout<WH07321><WTH8685>, O Israel<WH03478>; be glad<WH08055><WTH8798> and rejoice<WH05937><WTH8798> with all the heart<WH03820>, O daughter<WH01323> of Jerusalem<WH03389>.

The LORD<WH03068> hath taken away<WH05493><WTH8689> thy judgments<WH04941>, he hath cast out<WH06437><WTH8765> thine enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>: the king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478>, <FI>even<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>is<Fi> in the midst<WH07130> of thee: thou shalt not see<WH07200><WTH8799> evil<WH07451> any more.

In that day<WH03117> it shall be said<WH0559><WTH8735> to Jerusalem<WH03389>, Fear<WH03372><WTH8799> thou not: <FI>and to<Fi> Zion<WH06726>, Let not thine hands<WH03027> be slack<WH07503><WTH8799>. <RF>slack: or, faint<Rf>

The LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> in the midst<WH07130> of thee <FI>is<Fi> mighty<WH01368>; he will save<WH03467><WTH8686>, he will rejoice<WH07797><WTH8799> over thee with joy<WH08057>; he will rest<WH02790><WTH8686> in his love<WH0160>, he will joy<WH01523><WTH8799> over thee with singing<WH07440>. <RF>rest: Heb. be silent<Rf>

I will gather<WH0622><WTH8804> <FI>them that are<Fi> sorrowful<WH03013><WTH8737> for the solemn assembly<WH04150>, <FI>who<Fi> are of thee, <FI>to whom<Fi> the reproach<WH02781> of it <FI>was<Fi> a burden<WH04864>. <RF>reproach...: Heb. the burden upon it was reproach<Rf>

Behold, at that time<WH06256> I will undo<WH06213><WTH8802> all that afflict<WH06031><WTH8764> thee: and I will save<WH03467><WTH8689> her that halteth<WH06760><WTH8802>, and gather<WH06908><WTH8762> her that was driven out<WH05080><WTH8737>; and I will get<WH07760><WTH8804> them praise<WH08416> and fame<WH08034> in every land<WH0776> where they have been put to shame<WH01322>. <RF>get...: Heb. set them for a praise<Rf> <RF>where...: Heb. of their shame<Rf>

At that time<WH06256> will I bring<WH0935><WTH8686> you <FI>again<Fi> , even in the time<WH06256> that I gather<WH06908><WTH8763> you: for I will make<WH05414><WTH8799> you a name<WH08034> and a praise<WH08416> among all people<WH05971> of the earth<WH0776>, when I turn back<WH07725><WTH8800> your captivity<WH07622> before your eyes<WH05869>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
